title: Fleet Governor: Scaling Dial, Throughput Inspector, and Immutable Change Chronicle
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build the Fleet Governor workspace in the Console that lets operators configure scaling controls, inspect throughput and latency impacts, and review an immutable change chronicle. The goal is a single-pane operational surface where platform operators can: 1) set autoscaling policies and manual overrides at fleet or pool level, 2) preview expected RPS and cost delta before applying changes, and 3) see a tamper-evident history of scaling decisions and rollbacks for audit and incident reviews.
problem_statement: Operators currently use a mix of ad-hoc scripts and an early-stage UI to modify dedicated capacity. This causes configuration drift, lack of clear rollback paths, and difficulty correlating scaling changes to SLO fluctuations. We need an opinionated Console UX to reduce errors and accelerate troubleshooting while preserving strict auditability for enterprise customers.
goals: Expose a concise scaling control that supports policy types: target-based, schedule-based, and manual override
Provide an interactive throughput inspector showing 1m/5m/15m RPS, p50/p95/p99 latency, and token cost delta for a change
Implement an immutable change chronicle with actor, timestamp, rationale, diff view, and one-click rollback
Gate changes with role-based approvals (operators vs admins) and soft-apply simulation before commit
acceptance_criteria: Scaling control allows creating/updating policies for a fleet with fields: target_rps, min_instances, max_instances, cool_down_seconds, and policy_type
Throughput inspector renders projected RPS and latency delta within 3 seconds of input change; shows cost estimate and expected SLO impact
Change chronicle records every change with: actor, ISO timestamp, human reason, before/after JSON diff, and optional linked incident or PR
Rollback action re-applies previous config and emits a chronicle entry; rollback completes and reflects in telemetry within 60s
UI respects RBAC: non-admins can propose changes but require approval from 'Fleet Admin' role for P1-level modifications
End-to-end tests validate simulation vs actual outcome for a representative synthetic workload (90% match tolerance)
risks_and_trades: High-fidelity throughput estimation adds CPU cost to the control plane; trade-off between estimator accuracy and query cost
Exposing too many knobs increases operator errors; we'll default to 'guided' presets and hidden advanced options
Immutable chronicle size growth — need TTL/archival policy for older entries to bound storage costs
implementation_notes: Phase 1: GUI + basic target-based policy + chronicle append-only store (Postgres WAL-backed)
Phase 2: Add schedule-based and predictive autoscale with ML hints from Optimize signals
Phase 3: Approvals workflow and integration with audit log export (SIEM)
notifications_and_rollout: Soft-launch to internal operator group for 2 weeks with simulated workloads
Feature flag via remote-config to enable UI per org
Training doc and runbook to accompany GA
